tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 9 (investments) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 9) and spec.md (Currency & Account Support: investment accounts hold multiple assets; historical price tracking, manual + automatic updates) first. The data layer ALREADY has everything you persist — do NOT change it: models Asset { id; symbol; name; type: AssetType } (AssetType includes stock/etf/mutual/bond/commodity/crypto), Holding { id; accountId; assetId; units }, PricePoint { id; assetId; date (ISO); price }, the 'investment' account type, and repositories.assets / .holdings / .prices are wired. Reuse: src/stores/ (initializeStores in stores/index.ts; useAccountStore for investment accounts), src/lib/currency/ (formatCurrency), Recharts (already a dependency), src/pages/InvestmentsPage.tsx (a stub to replace). The /investments route + nav link already exist — do NOT touch routes or Layout.

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): latestPrice picks the PricePoint with the MOST RECENT date (ISO string compare) for an asset, or undefined. holdingValue = units × latestPrice, and is 0 when no price is known. portfolioValue sums holding values, optionally filtered by accountId. priceHistory returns an asset's points sorted ASCENDING by date. Prices are plain numbers in the base currency (PricePoint has no currency field). Automatic price updates go through a pluggable provider registry.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/investments/** (create), src/stores/investmentStore.ts (create), src/stores/index.ts (register the new store in initializeStores/resetStores + export it — do NOT change other stores), src/pages/InvestmentsPage.tsx (build the real page), and new src/components/investments/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, the other stores/pages, routes.tsx, Layout.tsx, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies (Recharts is already installed). Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it):
1. src/lib/investments/index.ts (pure valuation + provider registry, well-tested):
   - export function latestPrice(assetId: string, prices: PricePoint[]): number | undefined
   - export function holdingValue(holding: Holding, prices: PricePoint[]): number
   - export function portfolioValue(holdings: Holding[], prices: PricePoint[], accountId?: string): number
   - export function priceHistory(assetId: string, prices: PricePoint[]): PricePoint[]  // ascending by date
   - export interface PriceProvider { id: string; label: string; fetchPrice(symbol: string): Promise<number> }
   - export function registerPriceProvider(p: PriceProvider): void
   - export function getPriceProvider(id: string): PriceProvider | undefined
   - export function listPriceProviders(): string[]
   Register a built-in 'manual' provider, and ONE automatic provider that fetches a live price for a symbol (e.g. a crypto price endpoint) via fetch — best-effort; do not let its presence break tests (tests use a mock provider). Keep any network strictly inside the provider's fetchPrice.
2. src/stores/investmentStore.ts — Zustand store: initialize(repos); CRUD for ASSETS, HOLDINGS, and PRICE POINTS against repositories.assets/.holdings/.prices; in-memory lists; valuation selectors (holding values, per-account portfolio value) built on the pure functions; an updatePriceViaProvider(assetId, providerId) action that calls the provider's fetchPrice and records a PricePoint. Register it in src/stores/index.ts initializeStores/resetStores.
3. src/pages/InvestmentsPage.tsx — a real investments view: pick/scope to an investment account; manage assets (add/edit: symbol, name, type); manage holdings (add/edit units per asset); a portfolio overview (each holding: units, latest price, value, formatted via formatCurrency; plus total portfolio value); manual price entry (add a dated PricePoint) AND an 'update price' button that fetches via the automatic provider; and a PRICE HISTORY CHART per asset using Recharts (this satisfies 'price history renders'). Use ui/button, ui/card.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for the valuation functions, the provider registry, and the store (node env + fake-indexeddb for the store).

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the valuation semantics, the provider-registry design (and which automatic provider you wired), and any Phase 10 (reports) follow-up (e.g. folding portfolio value into net worth).

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + conventions exactly (latest by date; value = units × latest price; 0 when unknown; history ascending); do NOT change db/models; keep network only inside a provider; reuse existing layers; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (latestPrice picks the most recent; holdingValue = units × latest price and 0 when unknown; portfolioValue sums and filters by account; priceHistory ascending; the price-provider registry registers/resolves a provider). The investments module, investmentStore (registered in initializeStores) with asset/holding/price CRUD, and an InvestmentsPage with portfolio valuation, manual + provider price updates, and a Recharts price-history chart all exist. The Phase 3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
